description: Performs a Windows Server in-place OS upgrade via Windows Update or DISM. Takes an EBS snapshot (EC2) or VSS shadow copy (on-prem) before upgrade. Polls for agent re-registration after the reboot (up to 30 minutes). Full rollback via EBS volume swap.

target_version.label: Target Version
target_version.description: Target Windows Server version (e.g. 2022 or 2025). Supported paths: 2016→2019, 2019→2022.

iso_path.label: ISO Path
iso_path.description: Path to Windows Server ISO on the target host (required for DISM upgrade; omit for Windows Update)

health_check_command.label: Health Check Command
health_check_command.description: Optional PowerShell command to run post-upgrade to verify application health

skip_snapshot.label: Skip Snapshot
skip_snapshot.description: Skip pre-upgrade snapshot (not allowed on prod assets)

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run preflight and DISM compatibility check only — no changes applied

rollback.description: EC2 path: EBS root volume swap from pre-upgrade snapshot. On-prem path: VSS shadow copy restore. Agent re-registration verified after restore.

steps.description: Check disk space, validate upgrade path, run DISM compatibility scan
Take EBS snapshot (EC2) or VSS shadow copy (on-prem)
Trigger Windows Update or DISM upgrade; wait for agent re-registration
Confirm OS version, services, and optional application health check
